note: The MGRS lettering tables. The band letters, the 100 km column sets, the row letters and the AA-scheme row offset are defined by DMA TM 8358.1 (the lettering figures), DMA TM 8358.2 'The Universal Grids: UTM and UPS' Ed.1 1989, and the NGA MGRS guidance (Modified February 2009). No letter is invented: every letter here is one of those sources. The generated runtime projection is addons/core/data/mgrs_tables.sqf.

band_letters.note: Beginning at 80 S and proceeding northward, the 20 bands are lettered C through X, omitting I and O. Every band is 8 degrees high except band X, which is 12 degrees high. NGA MGRS guidance (Modified February 2009).

column_sets.note: The 100 km column letters cycle every three zones: set 1 for zones 1, 4, 7 ... (A to H), set 2 for zones 2, 5, 8 ... (J to R, omitting O), set 3 for zones 3, 6, 9 ... (S to Z). The set index is (zone - 1) mod 3. DMA TM 8358.1 and the NGA MGRS guidance.

row_letters.note: The 100 km row letters run A to V, omitting I and O, in a 20-row cycle. The row index is (northing / 100000) mod 20, shifted by the AA offset in even zones. DMA TM 8358.1 and the NGA MGRS guidance.

even_zone_row_offset.note: AA scheme (MGRS-New, WGS84): the first row letter just north of the equator is A in odd-numbered zones and F in even-numbered zones. F is index 5 of the row letters, so an even zone adds 5 to the row index mod 20. The older AL scheme (odd L, even R) is for local datums and is not used here. NGA MGRS guidance (Modified February 2009).

zone_strings.note: The UTM zone number as two characters. Leading zeroes are included so that zone 9 is 09. NGA MGRS guidance (Modified February 2009).

digit_characters.note: The decimal digits, indexed by value. The formatter builds the easting and northing digit groups from this table so the runtime never calls a string-to-number command.
